name: Tuneshine
author: daviidpaark
description: Sends album art and track metadata to a Tuneshine device on your LAN

users.reason: To receive scrobble and now-playing events for all users

http.reason: To send album art and metadata to the Tuneshine device

cache.reason: To deduplicate requests and avoid sending the same track twice

subsonicapi.reason: To fetch track artwork for sending to the Tuneshine device

host.title: Tuneshine Device Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of your Tuneshine device (e.g. tuneshine-1D78.local or 192.168.1.100)

servicename.title: Service Name
servicename.description: Name shown on the Tuneshine as the music source

user.title: Restrict to User(s)
user.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of Navidrome usernames allowed to update the display (e.g. "user1" or "user1,user2"). Leave blank to allow all users.
